PLAN "12-Week Strength & Mobility for Endometriosis (Start: 2026-06-01)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational strength and mobility"
  GOAL primary aerobic:
    name "Build aerobic base"
  GOAL secondary conditioning:
    name "Improve metabolic conditioning"
  GOAL secondary power:
    name "Develop plyometric power"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1-4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..15 rpe 6..7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..18 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 30..35m "Aerobic Base":
        modality:
          cycling 30..35m zone2
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body & Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..15 rpe 6..7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12..18 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45s rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday cardio 30..35m "Aerobic Base":
        modality:
          walking 30..35m zone2
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..15 rpe 6..7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12..18 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..22 rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday cardio 20..22m "HIIT (MetCon)":
        modality:
          cycling 5..6x1m hard, 2m easy (no HIIT if on flow or flare days)
      DAY Sunday plyometric 20..22m "Intro Plyometrics":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          box_jump 3..4x5 rest 90 seconds (no plyometrics if on flow or flare days)
          squat_jump 3..4x8 rest 90 seconds (no plyometrics if on flow or flare days)
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m

  PHASE "Progression" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5-8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..15 rpe 8..9 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..22 rpe 8..9 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 45..60m "Aerobic Base":
        modality:
          cycling 45..60m zone3
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body & Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4x8..12 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x10..18 rpe 8..9 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..20 rpe 8..9 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x60..90s rpe 8..9 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday cardio 45..60m "Aerobic Base":
        modality:
          walking 45..60m zone3
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower Body & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10..18 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 4x10..18 rpe 8..9 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x15..22 rpe 8..9 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x20..28 rpe 8..9 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday cardio 24..26m "HIIT (MetCon)":
        modality:
          cycling 7..8x1m hard, 2m easy (no HIIT if on flow or flare days)
      DAY Sunday plyometric 24..26m "Plyometrics":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          box_jump 4..5x6 rest 90 seconds (no plyometrics if on flow or flare days)
          squat_jump 4..5x10 rest 90 seconds (no plyometrics if on flow or flare days)
          skater_jump 3..4x8 rest 90 seconds (no plyometrics if on flow or flare days)
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m

  PHASE "Consolidation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9-12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4..2x10..8 rpe 7..6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4..2x10..8 rpe 7..6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4..2x10..8 rpe 7..6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3..2x15..10 rpe 7..6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 40..25m "Aerobic Base":
        modality:
          cycling 40..25m zone2
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body & Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4..2x10..8 rpe 7..6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4..2x12..10 rpe 7..6 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3..2x15..10 rpe 7..6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3..2x50..30s rpe 7..6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday cardio 40..25m "Aerobic Base":
        modality:
          walking 40..25m zone2
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4..2x12..10 rpe 7..6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 4..2x12..10 rpe 7..6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3..2x18..10 rpe 7..6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3..2x22..15 rpe 7..6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday cardio 20..12m "HIIT (MetCon)":
        modality:
          cycling 5..3x1m hard, 2m easy (no HIIT if on flow or flare days)
      DAY Sunday plyometric 20..10m "Plyometrics":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          box_jump 3..1x6 rest 90 seconds (no plyometrics if on flow or flare days)
          squat_jump 3..1x10 rest 90 seconds (no plyometrics if on flow or flare days)
          skater_jump 2x8 rest 90 seconds (no plyometrics if on flow or flare days, omit in week 12)
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m

NUTRITION
  PLAN "Anti-Inflammatory Support":
    GUIDELINES:
      - Emphasize whole, minimally processed foods.
      - Include a variety of colorful vegetables and fruits daily (aim for 5+ servings).
      - Prioritize omega-3 rich foods: fatty fish (salmon, sardine, mackerel), chia seeds, flaxseed, walnuts.
      - Use extra virgin olive oil as primary fat source.
      - Include whole grains: quinoa, brown rice, oats, buckwheat.
      - Choose lean proteins: fish, poultry, legumes, tofu, tempeh.
      - Incorporate anti-inflammatory herbs/spices: turmeric, ginger, garlic, cinnamon.
      - Limit red/processed meats, refined grains, and added sugars.
      - Avoid trans fats and minimize saturated fats.
      - Limit dairy to fermented options (yogurt, kefir) if tolerated.
      - Drink water as main beverage; limit alcohol and sugary drinks.
      - Consider magnesium-rich foods: leafy greens, pumpkin seeds, almonds, black beans.
      - Include probiotic and prebiotic foods: yogurt, kefir, sauerkraut, kimchi, onions, garlic, asparagus.
      - Adjust fiber intake to tolerance, especially during flare or flow days.
    SAMPLE_DAY:
      BREAKFAST:
        - Oatmeal with chia seeds, blueberries, walnuts, and cinnamon.
      LUNCH:
        - Grilled salmon over mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olive oil, and quinoa.
      SNACK:
        - Carrot sticks and hummus.
      DINNER:
        - Stir-fried tofu with broccoli, bell pepper, ginger, garlic, and brown rice.
      SNACK:
        - Plain yogurt with flaxseed and raspberries.
    NOTES:
      - During flare or flow days, opt for easy-to-digest foods (cooked vegetables, soups, stews).
      - Reduce raw cruciferous vegetables if bloating is present.
      - Maintain regular meal timing to support energy and hormone balance.
      - Consult with a registered dietitian for personalized adjustments.

      - Drink water as main beverage; limit alcohol and sugary drinks.
